title: Enchanting overhaul
subtitle: Matrix & More expensive
description: Enchanting has it's system replaced by quark matrix enchanting, and it is heavily nerfed
While enchanting a base item, it is difficult to get very far in enchanting it (Has been limited greatly)
This is intended to make enchants much more valuable and harder to obtain
You can influence the chance for certain enchant pieces using candles, up to candles can be used at once
§7§nSee next page for which enchants the candle colors influence
§l&#563A00Brown§r: Looting, Fortune, Luck of the Sea
§l§bLight Blue§r: Efficiency, Sharpness, Lure, Power, Impaling, Quick Charge
